page.layout: One page of running text, one column, full width. No margin notes, no catchword, no signature. A faint line of possible running head at the very top.
page.notes: The scan is so faint and washed out that no word can be read with confidence. The lines are visible only as traces of print, so every line is marked illegible and the paragraph breaks are approximate. Scattered faint marks near the top, and the faint marks at the left edge, could be stray ink or show-through and are not transcribed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature can be identified. A higher-contrast or better-lit scan is needed for a usable transcription.
